
{{alias}}( x, dims )
    Returns a reduced shape of a provided ndarray.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    dims: Array<integer>
        List of dimensions to reduce.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<integer>
        Reduced shape.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/zeros}}( [ 1, 2, 3, 2 ] ), [ 0, 1 ] )
    [ 3, 2 ]

    See Also
    --------
